snippet.title: Super Squash - Trailer
snippet.description:
Super Squash is an ongoing project that's been in the works for quite some time! With the completion of this trailer, you can expect not only to see an upcoming Steam store page for the title but a VERY soon launch as well! Stay tuned!


Music: The Animal Inside - Sinyells
